entries.title: Proverbs 2:1
segments: ¶My son, if thou receivest my words, and layest up my commandments with thee,

entries.title: Proverbs 2:2
segments: so that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom [and] thou apply thy heart to understanding;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:3
segments: yea, if thou criest after discernment [and] liftest up thy voice to understanding;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:4
segments: if thou seekest her as silver and searchest for her as for hidden treasures:

entries.title: Proverbs 2:5
segments: then shalt thou understand the fear of Jehovah, and find the knowledge of God.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:6
segments: For Jehovah giveth wisdom; out of his mouth [come] knowledge and understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:7
segments: He layeth up sound wisdom for the upright; [he] is a shield to them that walk in integrity;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:8
segments: guarding the paths of just judgment and keeping the way of his godly ones.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:9
segments: Then shalt thou understand righteousness and judgment and equity: every good path.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:10
segments: ¶When wisdom entereth into thy heart and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul,

entries.title: Proverbs 2:11
segments: discretion shall keep thee, understanding shall preserve thee:

entries.title: Proverbs 2:12
segments: To deliver thee from the way of evil, from the man that speaketh froward things;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:13
segments: [from those] who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:14
segments: who rejoice to do evil, [and] delight in the frowardness of evil;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:15
segments: whose paths are crooked, and who are perverted in their course:

entries.title: Proverbs 2:16
segments: To deliver thee from the strange woman, from the stranger who flattereth with her words;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:17
segments: who forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her God;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:18
segments: --for her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:19
segments: none that go unto her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life:

entries.title: Proverbs 2:20
segments: --that thou mayest walk in the way of the good, and keep the paths of the righteous.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:21
segments: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:22
segments: but the wicked shall be cut off from the land, and the unfaithful shall be plucked up out of it.
